title: Абсолютные причастные конструкции: Weather permitting, All things considered

why: Абсолютная конструкция — это короткий оборот со своим собственным подлежащим, который заменяет целое придаточное: причину, условие или время. По-русски похоже на «Погода позволяя...» или «Дело сделано — можно отдыхать». В английском это звучит кратко и литературно, а готовые формулы (Weather permitting) встречаются постоянно.
formation: • существительное + being + прилагательное: Time being short, ...
• существительное + having + V3: The tests having passed, ...
• существительное + V3 (пассивное значение): The work finished, ...
• with + существительное + причастие/прилагательное: with her eyes closed
Подлежащее оборота НЕ совпадает с подлежащим главной части — в этом отличие от обычного причастного оборота. Запятая отделяет оборот от главной части.
usage: 1. Условие (вместо if): Weather permitting, we'll fly on Friday. (Если позволит погода, мы вылетим в пятницу.)
2. Причина (вместо because): Time being short, we skipped the demo. (Так как времени было мало, мы пропустили демо.)
3. Время (вместо when/after): The tests having passed, we deployed. (Когда тесты прошли, мы выложили релиз.)
4. Сопутствующие обстоятельства, часто с with: He sat there with his arms crossed. (Он сидел со скрещёнными руками.)
5. Устойчивые формулы: All things considered (всё взвесив), other things being equal (при прочих равных), everything taken into account (учитывая всё), that said (тем не менее).
signalWords: Начало предложения: Weather permitting, Time being..., All things considered, Other things being equal, The work done... Часто в деловой и письменной речи.
mistakes: ✗ Weather permits, we'll go. → ✓ Weather permitting, we'll go. (нужно причастие, а не глагол: два глагола через запятую не соединить)
✗ Being time short, we left. → ✓ Time being short, we left. (подлежащее ставим перед being)
✗ The work finishing, we went home. → ✓ The work finished, we went home. (работа не «заканчивает», её закончили — нужна форма V3)
✗ All things considering → ✓ All things considered (вещи рассматриваются — V3)
✗ He sat with the arms crossed. → ✓ He sat with his arms crossed. (части тела — с притяжательным местоимением)
remember: Своё подлежащее + причастие, и вся мысль в одной фразе: Weather permitting, all things considered.

items.prompt: The weather ___ (permit), we'll have the barbecue outside.
items.answer: permitting

items.prompt: The work ___ (finish), the team went home.
items.answer: finished

items.prompt: Time ___ (be) short, we skipped the last item.
items.answer: being

items.prompt: All things ___ (consider), it was a good year.
items.answer: considered

items.prompt: The server ___ (crash), nobody could work.
items.answer: having crashed

items.prompt: Other things ___ (be) equal, I'd choose the cheaper one.
items.answer: being

items.prompt: Everything ___ (take) into account, the plan seems realistic.
items.answer: taken

items.prompt: Her homework ___ (do), she turned on the TV.
items.answer: done

items.prompt: ___, we'll start at nine. (a) Weather permitting (b) Weather permits
items.answer: (a) Weather permitting

items.prompt: The meeting ___, everyone left. (a) finishing (b) finished
items.answer: (b) finished

items.prompt: She sat there with her eyes ___. (a) close (b) closed
items.answer: (b) closed

items.prompt: ___, we cut the demo. (a) Being time short (b) Time being short
items.answer: (b) Time being short

items.prompt: All things ___, I think we should accept. (a) considered (b) considering
items.answer: (a) considered

items.prompt: He walked in, ___. (a) a book in his hand (b) a book is in his hand
items.answer: (a) a book in his hand

items.prompt: ___ equal, the younger candidate gets the job. (a) Everything else being (b) Everything else is
items.answer: (a) Everything else being

items.prompt: The deadline ___, we worked all weekend. (a) approaching (b) approached
items.answer: (a) approaching

items.prompt: If the weather permits, we will fly on Friday. (Begin: Weather...)
items.answer: Weather permitting, we will fly on Friday.

items.prompt: Because time was short, we skipped lunch. (Begin: Time...)
items.answer: Time being short, we skipped lunch.

items.prompt: When the tests had passed, we deployed the code. (Begin: The tests...)
items.answer: The tests having passed, we deployed the code.

items.prompt: If we consider everything, the project was a success. (Begin: All things...)
items.answer: All things considered, the project was a success.

items.prompt: As the road was closed, we took the train. (Begin: The road...)
items.answer: The road being closed, we took the train.

items.prompt: She stood at the door and her arms were crossed. (Use with)
items.answer: She stood at the door with her arms crossed.

items.prompt: Because the budget had been cut, the team was smaller. (Begin: The budget...)
items.answer: The budget having been cut, the team was smaller.

items.prompt: If other things are equal, I prefer remote work. (Begin: Other things...)
items.answer: Other things being equal, I prefer remote work.

items.prompt: Weather permits, we'll go hiking.
items.answer: Weather permitting, we'll go hiking.

items.prompt: Being time short, we left early.
items.answer: Time being short, we left early.

items.prompt: The work finishing, we went home.
items.answer: The work finished, we went home. / The work having finished, we went home.

items.prompt: All things considering, it was fine.
items.answer: All things considered, it was fine.

items.prompt: Walking along the river, the rain began.
items.answer: As we were walking along the river, the rain began. / Walking along the river, we felt the rain begin.

items.prompt: He sat with the arms crossed.
items.answer: He sat with his arms crossed.

items.prompt: Having been said that, I agree with you.
items.answer: Having said that, I agree with you. / That said, I agree with you.

items.prompt: She left the room, the door was open behind her.
items.answer: She left the room, the door open behind her. / She left the room with the door open behind her.

items.prompt: Если позволит погода, мы поедем на озеро в субботу.
items.answer: Weather permitting, we will go to the lake on Saturday.

items.prompt: Времени мало, поэтому мы пропустим презентацию.
items.answer: Time being short, we will skip the presentation.

items.prompt: Всё взвесив, я принял предложение.
items.answer: All things considered, I accepted the offer.

items.prompt: Когда тесты прошли, мы выпустили релиз.
items.answer: The tests having passed, we released the update.

items.prompt: Он вошёл в офис с ноутбуком под мышкой.
items.answer: He walked into the office with a laptop under his arm.

items.prompt: При прочих равных условиях я бы выбрал этот вариант.
items.answer: Other things being equal, I would choose this option.

items.prompt: Работа закончена, и мы пошли домой.
items.answer: The work finished, we went home. / The work being finished, we went home.

items.prompt: Она сидела с закрытыми глазами и слушала музыку.
items.answer: She sat with her eyes closed, listening to music.
